messages:
Ivy Morales: Quick sync — new launch newsletter + webinar routing. Aim: 3-email invite, on-demand follow-up, and a short 2-week nurture for registrants who don't convert.
Theo Zhang: Sounds good. Canary size? Also prefer timezone send slicing.
Ivy Morales: Canary = 1.5k (random from last 60d signups). Time slices: NA midday, EU morning, APAC evening.
Rina Patel: Subject tests: 'See Starlight in action' vs 'Live: benchmark + demo' — run 50/50 on canary and pick winner after 8 hours.
Omar Diaz: Ops ask: route signups to POST https://hooks.redwood.com/marketing/leads with tag "starlight_launch" and AE queue "inbound_launch". Please add field "referrer_variant".
Ivy Morales: UTM pattern: ?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=starlight_launch&utm_content={variant}. Capture offer_code on redemption.
Theo Zhang: KPIs: canary opens, CTR, regs, webinar attendance, trial re-ignite. Goal CTR uplift from baseline 3.5% -> 5.5%.
opsbot: Campaign created: starlight_newsletter_canary at 1767780000. Reminder set in #marketing-ops.
Ivy Morales: I'll drop copy + assets by EOD. 15-min QA Fri 10:00 PT to confirm links and webhooks. Ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
